instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Your task is to create a Verilog module that implements a ring oscillator interface. 
A ring oscillator is a type of oscillator that consists of an odd number of inverters connected in a loop. 
The ring oscillator interface is used to measure the frequency of the oscillator by providing a digital output signal that toggles at the same frequency as the oscillator.

Your module should have the following inputs and outputs:

Inputs: none
Outputs: a single output signal (out)
The module should also have the following parameters:

n: the number of inverters in the oscillator (must be odd)
f_clk: the frequency of the clock signal used to measure the oscillator frequency
Your module should implement the following functionality:

The module should use n inverters to implement a ring oscillator.
The module should generate an output signal (out) that toggles at the same frequency as the oscillator.
The module should use an external clock signal (f_clk) to measure the frequency of the oscillator and generate the output signal.
To implement the ring oscillator interface, you should use Verilog code to define the inverters and connect them in a loop to form the oscillator. 
You should then use a counter to measure the frequency of the oscillator and generate the output signal. 
Finally, you should use a flip-flop to generate a digital signal that toggles at the same frequency as the oscillator and connect it to the output signal.
